text:
maya_cs: Kicking off Verdance onboarding — short thread to align stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and obvious risks. 🙌
sam_ae: Thanks Maya. Quick intros: Verdance lead is Jordan (product), they'll handle data access. Our owner is Sam (AE) — I'll help with commercial check-ins.
jordan_verdance: Hi all — excited. Our main goal is live pilot with search + assistant by end of month. Need SSO + sample CSV.
liam_se: Noted. Deliverables from us: test API keys, sample integration guide, and smoke tests. I'll own technical runbook.
priya_pm: Proposed timeline (high level):
```
Week 0: creds + SSO + sample data
Week 1: dev integration + smoke tests
Week 2: pilot content + QA
Week 3: rollout plan + enablement
Week 4: pilot metrics review + go/no-go
```
maya_cs: Success criteria we should agree on: 1) assistant live in staging with 3 core flows; 2) latency P95 < 800ms for typical prompt; 3) user satisfaction >= 4/5 on 100 evals; 4) pilot engagement > 1k queries/week.
anya_support: I'll own enablement materials: runbook, support playbook, and a one-pager for Verdance ops. Need product screenshots and example prompts.
sam_ae: Renewal risk flags to watch for: stalled SSO, missing sample data, or <50% seat adoption by end of pilot. If any appear, flag as high-risk and we open an exec sync.
jordan_verdance: We'll prioritize SSO this week. Also can assign 2 engineers for integration.
liam_se: For rollout: ask for a test dataset (anonymized) + a sample user to mirror traffic. Also request IP allowlist for dedicated endpoints, if needed.
maya_cs: Risks & mitigations: SSO delay -> temporary token flow + clear support SLA; data gaps -> create small synthetic dataset; model quality -> prompt tuning workshop with Jordan + product.
deploy-bot: Reminder: created onboarding board -> https://board.internal/verdance-onboard, added initial tasks.
priya_pm: Action items (owners):
- Jordan: share sample CSV + SSO contact by Tue (owner: jordan_verdance)
- Liam: publish runbook + smoke tests by Wed (owner: liam_se)
- Anya: draft enablement one-pager by Thu (owner: anya_support)
- Maya/Sam: schedule weekly 30-min check-in (owner: maya_cs)
maya_cs: I'll follow up with calendar invite. Thanks everyone — post updates here so we have a single log. :thumbsup:
